result.document_summary: Newark, NJ Municipal Code Chapter 2:31 (Ban the Box), whose Article 1 restricts criminal-history screening of rental applicants by landlords and real estate brokers, and whose Article 2 covers City licensing.
result.notes: Only Article 1 (Housing) is in scope; Article 2 (Licensing) concerns City licenses and was ignored. The page gives no effective date for Article 1 beyond the ordinance adoption date 4-15-2015 (Ord. 6 PSF-B), which is cited in the section history and is not stated as an effective date, so effective_date is left blank. The ordinance cites a prior 2012 ordinance as repealed in its entirety.

rules.title: Newark Ban the Box: criminal history screening of rental applicants
rules.requirement: Landlords and brokers may inquire into criminal history only after a formal application and written notice and consent, may look back only 8 years for indictable convictions and 5 years for disorderly persons/ordinance convictions (certain serious offenses at any time), may not use non-pending arrests, expunged/sealed records or juvenile adjudications, must weigh rehabilitation factors, and must give written reasons and the results within 10 business days of an adverse decision.
rules.key_value: Lookback: 8 years (indictable), 5 years (disorderly persons/ordinance); after formal application only
rules.quoted_span: Inquiry into and consideration of any applicant's criminal history shall take place only after the applicant has submitted a formal application.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to rentals, leases and subleases of real property in Newark by landlords and real estate brokers, except certain owner-occupied small dwellings.

exemptions.label: Single apartment in a two-family dwelling where the owner occupies the other unit

all_of.text: Rental of a single apartment or flat in a two family dwelling
the other occupancy unit of which is occupied by the owner as his/her residence or the household of his/her family at the time of such rental

exemptions.label: Room rental in an owner-occupied one-family dwelling

all_of.text: Rental of a room or rooms by the owner or occupant of a one-family dwelling
occupied by him/her as his/her residence or the household of his/her family at the time of such rental

rules.exemptions_text: Does not apply to a single apartment in an owner-occupied two-family dwelling or a room rental in an owner-occupied one-family dwelling; also does not apply where federal or state law requires or permits criminal-history consideration (limited to those offenses and periods) or to property in government programs encouraging housing for people with criminal histories.
rules.interaction: Prohibitions do not apply where federal or state law, regulation or rule requires or permits consideration of criminal history, limited to the offenses and time periods that law allows.
yields_to: Federal or state law, regulation or rule requiring or permitting consideration of criminal history
